plainText:
Rhonda Krempa (born Natasha Charles Parker Malinsky) is an American voice actress who worked for the English-language dub of .

== Pokémon roles ==
Krempa joined the series during the ninth season, when and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. She left the series in the thirteenth season, with both her main roles of and going to Bella Hudson.
